text:
No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected within ASSET-B between 2021 and 2025. Hansen data covered the whole property (100% valid observations) through 2025.

- The only post-2021 loss was about 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches below the 0.5 ha event threshold, so it was not counted as an event.
- The EU JRC map shows no forest on the property in 2020 (0 ha).
- Earlier loss occurred before the baseline, including 67.7 ha in 2020 and 25.5 ha in 2015. This is outside your question's period.

Limits: this doesn't prove that no change happened. Very small, edge, or narrow changes (under 30 m pixels) may be missed. It also isn't a compliance finding, and it says nothing about periods outside 2021–2025.
